correctness.rationale: For three-wise independent Bernoulli rows, the first three factorial moments of the sum are the ordered distinct-coordinate products. Under rare scaling at unit intensity they converge to one. The identity \(S^3=(S)_3+3(S)_2+S\) gives a uniform third-moment bound, hence uniform integrability through order two. The converse moment-correction formulas satisfy mass, first factorial moment, second factorial moment, and third factorial moment exactly; their perturbations are \(O(n^{-1})\) except for the new atom mass \(O(n^{-3})\), so positivity follows for each fixed finite target. Mixing and truncation handle arbitrary admissible targets.

value.rationale: The theorem resolves the first higher-wise case left open by the pairwise weak-limit classification at the canonical unit intensity. It gives a complete attainable set, identifies the exact change in which moment can escape under weak convergence, and supplies exact exchangeable equal-marginal realizing arrays. This is a structural law-of-small-numbers boundary result rather than a numerical example or routine restatement.
